records.text: Back, as I—until they started acting weird. Against the Darkness writes, 'Candace has shifted the collective consciousness of the masses to see through the deception and lies. Charlie (Charlie Kirk) predicted this. Rest well, Charlie (Charlie Kirk). You were never forgotten.' Thank you for saying that. I do think this is what we're doing right now
